name: Quality Engineering & Hardening (SDLC Phase 8)
description: Ensuring product quality and reliability — aka QA, Verification & Validation, Test Fest, Quality Gate.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Quality Engineering & Hardening
capabilities.description: Verifies the product meets functional, performance, security, and accessibility quality bars before it is exposed to real users.

services.name: Master Test Plan
services.contractDescription: Comprehensive testing strategy covering unit, integration, system, regression, and UAT methodologies.

services.name: Test Cases & Traceability Matrix
services.contractDescription: Requirement-to-test mapping matrix ensuring 100% functional acceptance criteria coverage.

services.name: Automated Test Suite Reports
services.contractDescription: CI test run outputs, flaky test isolation reports, and automated regression suite execution logs.

services.name: Performance & Load Test Plan/Results
services.contractDescription: k6 / Locust load test execution results, latency percentile distribution, and bottleneck analysis.

services.name: Security Testing Report
services.contractDescription: DAST penetration testing, dependency vulnerability report, and static code security analysis output.

services.name: Accessibility Audit
services.contractDescription: axe-core automated audit and manual screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver) accessibility test report.

services.name: UAT Plan & Sign-off Report
services.contractDescription: User acceptance test script execution, defect triage log, and business stakeholder sign-off.

policies.name: Zero Critical Defects Release Standard Policy

checklists.name: Quality Engineering & Hardening (SDLC Phase 8) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for test coverage, performance load testing, security audits, and UAT sign-off.

items.statement: The test cases and traceability matrix demonstrate coverage against every requirement in scope for this release.
Automated regression suite passes 100% clean with zero flaky test failures in the deployment candidate build.
Performance load testing verifies p95 latency targets under 1.5x peak anticipated load.
Security penetration testing and DAST scans report zero unresolved High or Critical vulnerabilities.
UAT sign-off report is formally approved by business stakeholders with zero blocking open defects.

reviewGates.name: Quality Engineering Review
reviewGates.statement: The Test Report / Results (automated test suite, performance, security, and accessibility testing) have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Scale & Performance Optimization.
reviewGates.prompt: Do the Test Report / Results show sufficient quality, coverage, and hardening to justify moving into Scale & Performance Optimization?
